items: Fewer sign-in asks: record finished sign-ins, AWS/Slack out of the browser, one ask per site
Refuse a secret ask that repeats a key the squad already holds
Let the PM take away cards it says to ignore
Read the board in the design-QA upgrade test instead of racing its event
Decided requests apart from production; one sign-in ask; run-lane binding test
Blocked on missing work: name it, equipe makes the ticket, no more relay
PM context: say each turn's blocks once per conversation, then only what changed
Let verification roles run tests on Codex in a disposable copy
AI platforms: sign out, switch account and a real reason for "Couldn't check"
Machine credentials first: no sign-in card while one already works
Squad health: ticket budgets, spend alarms and a self-watch
Growth: the growth loop — evidence, cards, tickets, measured outcomes
Stop baton loops: cap hand-overs between hand-ins and checklist growth
Run a project's go-live command after landed work is pushed
Requests: name the request a ticket serves, only work covers one, close honestly
Waiting on you: one list of everything waiting on the person, told to them and the PM
Make Always answer a kept-login sign-in card
Give runtime tests' event wait 45s on loaded CI runners
Needs you: every project's and the PM desk's, with what each asks; small talk opens no request
Metrics: read-only ad-hoc HogQL queries through a squad's connection
Don't open main-red tickets for equipe's own advisory checks
Close a person's request only when its work is live
List Metrics connection keys under Keys & secrets
Land finished work now: red main, decide-and-tell choices, additive migrations
Count only a branch's own files when weighing who lands it
Pacing never blocks the person; held turns say why; orphans reaped; lighter lanes
Keep work going when a plan or model runs out mid-turn
Design QA only when needed: precheck first, no designer while it runs, cheaper bounded turns
Push main when a member lands its own work
One ticket per request: driver, checklist, baton, self-landing, no meta tickets
Squad autonomy policy: levels, hard floor, standing allowances
Stay responsive on an overloaded Mac: board in memory, patient hellos, load pacing, no whole-disk searches
Design session pages: root addresses served, files checked, the page looked at before "sent"
Keep squad-folder git off the daemon's loop
Land accepted work one at a time per repository
Remote-aware: design session pages and everything shown reach the person's screen wherever it is
A project's page has a "What's live" tab, and the sidebar says when a project's work went live and what it brought
equipe tells you when work you asked for is live, in its conversation and as a notification (Settings › Notifications › Work goes live)
Restart to Update says what's new, and after updating equipe says once what the update brought
Pinned conversations get their own section at the top
